au.title: App updates
au.hint: NoCapOS checks your App Store apps for fresh images on its own, at start and every 6 hours, and drops what it finds in the App Store and Glow Up.
au.notifyHint: A heads-up when an app you installed has a fresh image.
au.notYet: Not checked yet: the first check runs a few minutes after start.
au.none: All your apps are fresh. No cap.
